$comment: Tables that are INTENTIONALLY readable by the anonymous (unauthenticated) role. Any other public-schema table that returns rows to the anon key fails `npm run check:public-access`. Adding an entry here is a deliberate security decision — justify it in the `reason` field.

tables.packages: Public marketplace catalogue (skills, playbooks, souls). Read-only listing data.
tables.pack_items: Join rows for public curated packs; contain no user data.
tables.profiles: Public author identity only (display fields). Sensitive columns are withheld by column-level policies; referral codes live in user_referral_codes.
